errors.model: The speech model is not on this computer yet.
errors.dependency: Local speech recognition (faster-whisper) is not installed in the backend.
errors.offline: Strict offline mode blocks the speech model download.
errors.download: The speech model could not be downloaded.

errors.timeout: Speech recognition did not answer in time.
errors.transcription: The audio could not be transcribed.

settings.title: Voice assistant
settings.description: Open the assistant from anywhere in WorkPilot and tell it what to do.
settings.shortcutHelp: Click Change, then press the new combination. Escape cancels.

conflict.invalid: Use Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ with a letter, a digit, a function key or Space, or a key from F13 to F24 alone (a foot pedal).
conflict.altgr: Ctrl+Alt is AltGr on many keyboards (it types @, € or [). Choose another combination.
conflict.used: {{shortcut}} is already used by WorkPilot or by the system.

settings.systemWide: Even when WorkPilot is in the background
settings.systemWideHelp: Registers the shortcut with the operating system: pressing it brings WorkPilot forward and opens the assistant. Takes effect when you save.
settings.systemWideRefused: The system refused this shortcut (another app may use it, or the desktop does not allow it). It still works inside WorkPilot.
settings.speech: Speech is transcribed on this computer (Whisper). No audio is kept.
settings.model: Simple commands are understood without a model. Other sentences use the “Voice assistant” model of Settings → Agent.
settings.sensitivityHelp: How far above the room's noise your voice must be to count as speech. The first moments of each session measure the room; choose Low in a noisy place.

feedbackLevels.verbose: Verbose: the answers and the running tasks

settings.feedbackHelp: Said with your system's voices, on this computer. In continuous mode, the microphone ignores what the assistant says.
settings.feedbackUnavailable: No local voice is installed on this system, so nothing can be said aloud.
settings.wakeHelp: When the continuous mode is off, the microphone waits for this phrase, then opens the assistant. A pulsing light and a mute button stay on screen. Speech is transcribed on this computer.

stop.confirm: Stop the running agents after their current step?
stop.explain: Each running task finishes the tool call it is in, does not start the next one, and waits for you to resume it from its card.
stop.stopping_one: {{count}} task stops after its current step.
stop.stopping_other: {{count}} tasks stop after their current step.
stop.failed: A running task could not be asked to stop. Use Stop all agents.

continuous.offer: Keep the microphone on between commands, with a pulsing light and a mute button.

phase.paused: Paused while the panel is open

continuous.hint: Speak a command. Pause when you are done.

continuous.sayYes: Say “yes” or “no”, or use the buttons.
